records.title: Blue crab
records.author: Julian Johnson-Mortimer
records.changes: Complete source model; UV-preserving simplification and rigid scale/orientation. Blue crab units are source carapace width; octopus units are the full horizontal arm envelope. Source image bytes unmodified. Original material replaced with shared marine response; untextured octopus receives authored muted skin colour and retains original normal map.
records.limits: Artist reference without precise taxonomic certification. Blue crab is a coastal sand/grass visitor in this mixed-source demonstration, not a verified local reef population. Octopus is not identified as Octopus cyanea. Original CC BY or CC BY-NC restrictions retained.
